# 1785. Minimum Elements to Add to Form a Given Sum

## Solution 1 (time O(1), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def minElements(self, nums, limit, goal):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :type limit: int
        :type goal: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        return (abs(sum(nums) - goal) + limit - 1) // limit
```
